runners.name: plebania
runners.label: planwat-plebania
runners.note: The home server: fast, but often switched off. With every runner at speed 1 it takes an equal share of the plan, then helps whoever is still crawling (steal.py). Takes the WIG census (the Joomla tree Incapsula keeps from the VPS's datacenter address), at most once a week and after its own crawl, so a new programme directory is crawled by whoever has WIG. Takes WTC whenever it is up: WTC's wall refuses the VPS's address (blocked in 4 of 4 passes up to 2026-10-26, plain HTTPS from the box answers 403), so on oracle it only ever cost a wall wait and a handoff. Since 2026-10-27 the same wall also closes this line for WTC, WLO, WEL, WML and WIG; with PLANWAT_RELAY_URL set WLO, WEL, WML and WIG go through the Cloudflare Worker relay (docs/EGRESS.md), while WTC still answers 403 from the relay's western egress, so its preference keeps the fast machine first when its line is clean.

runners.name: oracle
runners.label: planwat-oracle
runners.note: The free Oracle VPS (deploy/runner/): slow and weak, but always up. Covers everything while plebania is off. Takes WIG and IOE whenever it is up, so the fast machine's share stays on the faculties only it gets through: WIG tested from both runners on 2026-10-26 (two passes each, 33/33 groups, identical calendars); IOE crawled clean from here in 9 of 9 passes. WLO/WEL, WML and WTC answer this address with their walls when fetched directly; with PLANWAT_RELAY_URL and PLANWAT_RELAY_TOKEN set (docs/EGRESS.md) WLO, WEL and WML ride the Cloudflare Worker relay, WTC still gets 403 from the relay's western egress (so it stays with plebania), and WCY stays on the pool (EGRESS_FAIL_CLOSED).

runners.name: northflank
runners.label: planwat-northflank
runners.note: A free Northflank container (deploy/runner/Dockerfile.runner, no egress box), on a Google Cloud address (34.187.35.3). Tried on 2026-10-27, three groups each: IOE, WIG and WIM get through; WCY, WLO, WML and WTC answer 403, and WEL listed but its pages did not read (it shares WLO's lane anyway). With PLANWAT_RELAY_URL and PLANWAT_RELAY_TOKEN set (no egress needed) the Worker covers WLO, WEL and WML as well as WIG; on 2026-10-27 those answered 200 from this box through the relay. WTC still answered 403 from Cloudflare's western egress, so it stays with plebania (oracle's relay sees the same 403), and WCY still needs the pool this box does not have. Without the relay do not list WLO, WEL or WML here: their walls refuse this address. Not always_on: a free container may be paused, and it keeps no volume, so a restart needs a new registration token.
